note: The only consumer files `clossys compile` reads. Paths are relative to the consumer's clossys/ folder; `*` matches one path segment. A `glob` entry names files directly; a `pinned` entry names pin.json files and resolves each to the candidate file it pins (agents/<agent>/<slot>/candidates/<pin.candidate>). Everything else compile reads is package code. A change to the rendered output must trace to a changed file in this list (R-COMPILE-PURE).

inputs.decision: IA shape: L1/L2 grouping and leaves, per agent
Slot not needed (slot.json notNeeded), with the slot's contract and IA position
The content map: pinned Publisher publication and page records
Approved Writer keys: key text and status live in the pinned Writer candidate records
Pinned candidate files for every other agent slot
